method.measurements: wall-clock queue/readback/native-window wait times, process CPU time; not GPU timestamps or displayed FPS
method.summary: Median of three trial means; each trial equally averages its two maps at the same pixel size. P95 entries are means of scene P95s, not pooled percentiles.
method.metal: Native drawable backpressure remains despite requested vsync=0. Metal source presentation behavior is unchanged; baseline/optimized variation is test noise.

incompleteTrials.reason: Test process exited before final report; no engine exception recorded. Retained privately and repeated as a complete trial. Original complete OpenGL slowdown trial was kept in all statistics.

isolation.source: Exported engine base plus two optimized render modules; identical current performance driver for measured stages.
isolation.assets: Only imported game-version assets from previous task-owned fresh imports; no saves/options copied.

limits: no GPU timestamps or displayed FPS acceptance
no claim about all gameplay/fullscreen/context loss/platforms
existing protected runtime not altered; external load not controlled

love11Compatibility.reason: Single trials, marked Emerald slowdown; separate baseline replay also severely slow. No 11.5 speedup is claimed.

diagnostics.conclusion: Existing full-atlas recolour is a substantial drawing bottleneck; no growing texture storage observed in these short intervals. Does not explain every trial variation or prove absence of every regression.
